patch:
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
+# Set default behavior to automatically normalize text files to LF on Windows and Linux.
+* text=auto eol=lf
+
 # Golden outputs are compared byte for byte (the post writes LF line
 # ends): pin them to LF in every checkout, whatever core.autocrlf says.
 crates/*/tests/golden/** text eol=lf
@@ -7,17 +10,23 @@ crates/*/tests/fixtures/** text eol=lf
 # The Agie control reads CRLF records. Preserve the tested native bytes.
 crates/post/tests/golden/agie-setup/* -text whitespace=trailing-space,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol
 
+# Explicit binary rules for 3D geometry fixtures so Git never alters them.
+# Follows fixture rules so binary fixtures retain binary attributes.
+*.step binary
+*.stp binary
+*.stl binary
+
 # Machine definitions and fixture descriptions are included or parsed with LF.
 crates/*/tests/**/*.mch text eol=lf
 assets/machines/**/*.mch text eol=lf
 
 # 3D models and test fixtures are parsed with LF line ends.
 # The STL rule is for ASCII STL only: a binary STL fixture needs its own
 # later `-text` line, or Git changes its bytes on `git add`.
-testdata/**/*.step text eol=lf
-testdata/**/*.stp text eol=lf
-testdata/**/*.stl text eol=lf
-testdata/**/*.obj text eol=lf
+testdata/**/*.step text diff merge eol=lf
+testdata/**/*.stp text diff merge eol=lf
+testdata/**/*.stl text diff merge eol=lf
+testdata/**/*.obj text diff merge eol=lf
 
 # Skill and agent definitions are parsed by xtask tests with LF.
 .claude/** text eol=lf
@@ -47,5 +56,12 @@ crates/post/tests/klartext/contour.cnc text eol=lf
 # Solidcraft designs are ZIP containers: never touch their bytes.
 *.sc binary
 
+# Binary assets and image fixtures that Git must not touch or re-encode.
+# Kept after fixture rules so image fixtures never inherit text normalization.
+*.png binary
+*.ico binary
+*.woff binary
+*.woff2 binary
+
 # Agie controller files have byte-exact CRLF record terminators.
 crates/app/tests/golden/nc/agie-native/* -text whitespace=trailing-space,space-before-tab,cr-at-eol
